goal.description: What the intent wants true once this is built, restated for the steps after you: they read the spec, not the intent.

constraints.description: What the work must respect, from the intent and from this repository's rules. Empty when none applies.

approach.description: The change in a paragraph: what it does, and why this way rather than another.

placement.description: Where each concept the change adds or moves lives, by the boundaries the repository's own rules define, shown to the person who approves the spec. Empty only when the change adds or moves no concept.

concept.description: The concept: a rule, a type, a verb, a page, a file of its own.

where.description: The module or boundary it lives in, in the terms the repository's own rules use.

rule.description: The repository rule that puts it there: the file that states or holds it, and its words.

rejected.description: The neighbouring place it could have gone, and why not there; null when the rules leave no other.

changes.description: Every path the change touches, by path from the workspace root, each with one line on what changes in it.

path.description: A file you have read, or one the change adds.

where.description: The module or boundary the path lives in, in the terms the repository's own rules use.

why.description: Why the change lives there and not in the neighbouring module or boundary, citing the rule that decides it.

change.description: One line on what changes in it.

steps.description: The work, in order: each a thing an engineer can do and check was done.

tests.description: What proves the change: each test to add or change, and for a rule, the fixture that makes it refuse.

risks.description: What could go wrong, what the tests would not catch, and what you are unsure of. Empty when nothing is.

decisions.description: Every decision a round with the person settled, in order. Empty when you asked nothing.

answeredBy.description: `person`, or who answered on their behalf, as the answer says.

sources.description: Each page outside the repository the spec rests on, as you read it: the steps after you read this in place of the page, and may fetch none of it. Empty when the spec rests on no outside page.

url.description: The page's address, as you fetched it.

read.description: The day you read it, YYYY-MM-DD.

excerpt.description: The passage each claim rests on, word for word, not the whole page; several passages are separated by a line holding only an ellipsis (…).

claims.description: What the spec takes from the page, each claim in a line.

budgets.description: The budget you propose for each step of this run after yours, by its name: the dollars it may spend across its tries, and in `why` the figures of recent runs the amount went by. The approval of your gate makes them those steps' caps; the person may change any of them there.

open.description: What is still undecided, each as a question with its options and your recommendation. Empty only when nothing is.
